name: calcom_get_available_slots
description: Get open time slots for an event type in a date range. Provide `eventTypeId`, `start` and `end` (UTC ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-25T00:00:00Z), and optional `timeZone` (default UTC). Availability already excludes busy times from any calendar connected to cal.com (e.g. the user's Google Calendar). Returns slots grouped by date.

eventTypeId.description: The event type's numeric id (from calcom_list_event_types).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the returned slots (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.
